card.text: Explore Daphnis in 3D with Cassini imagery and its measured irregular shape.

introduction.text: Daphnis travels inside the Keeler Gap in Saturn’s A ring. This tiny moon raises waves along the gap’s edges, while Cassini’s close views reveal ridges and a coating of fine material. The displayed 2026 orbit extrapolates a 2005–2018 fit; Horizons has no ephemeris at this date. Its orientation uses an arbitrary display phase, not a measured attitude.

normal.title: ISS mosaic
normal.summary: Green-filter detail is combined with clear-filter images. Brightness matching reduces shading; the gray grid marks gaps.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height relative to a 3.8 km sphere, from the Cassini shape model. Small craters are unresolved.
